clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers a ritual blessing drawn from Agamaggan's ancient power. Bring blood shards taken from his Bristleback rivals, and he strengthens your will and spirit.

Held in a cage at Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth knows the geomancy and ancestral magic of the quilboar. He takes pride in his people's devotion to their creator, the Great Boar Agamaggan. To Mangletooth, an unbroken spirit carries a warrior onward when strength fails and defeat seems near.

Mangletooth asks for blood shards to raise your spirit. These crystals hold Agamaggan's ancient blood, which seeped into the red earth ten thousand years ago. Bring him shards gathered across the Barrens, especially from his Bristleback enemies, and he can channel their power into a blessing that bolsters your will.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Warriors of all types have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess in battle.
Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Our greatest warriors, and our greatest shamans would envy your will, traveler.
Defeat more of the Bristlebacks knowing that they cannot stop you!
